Re: Retail Liquor License Application
Dear Mayor Kaysen & Members of the Cheyenne City Council
Central Enterprises, Inc. is excited to submit the enclosed Application for the Retail Liquor
License currently available.
Our vision is to create a new venue in Downtown Cheyenne providing high-end casual dining.
Our product will include private dining services, a tavern, package liquor and catering services.
We are especially focus on the delivery of private dining capabilities and catering our product
throughout thebroader Cheyenne Community.We believe both of these services are under
served in the Cheyenne area.
Our plan includes renovating an historic building at the very visible corner of 17th Street and
Carey Avenue (1701 Carey).We believe our project will positively contribute to downtown
Cheyenne through the beautification of thebuilding, providing an exciting downtown destination
and delivering a superior experience for our custormers. Our project is consistent with the goals
of the City and more specifically the Downtown Development Authority (DDA).
I look forward to speaking with each of you regarding this exciting opportunity.Should you have
any questions I can be reached through my office at (307) 632-9590.We look forward to
working with you.
Respectfully Yours,
